name: Olecranon Fracture
definition: Fracture of the olecranon process, commonly from direct trauma or a fall, sometimes disrupting the extensor mechanism.

core: Ulnar nerve and distal neurovascular exam

investigations.principle: AP/lateral elbow radiographs usually establish diagnosis.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when the condition-specific question requires soft-tissue, neural, marrow or occult-injury assessment.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs/CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Displaced fractures with extensor-mechanism disruption often require fixation.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Kurpara-bhagna principles may complement rehabilitation after stabilization.

patientEducation.summary: Fracture of the olecranon process, commonly from direct trauma or a fall, sometimes disrupting the extensor mechanism.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for major trauma, acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe infection/systemic illness, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
